name: kalam-match
description: How many matches this node plays at once: `concurrency.slots` concurrent runs, each claiming one queued row on this runner's engine digest and playing it to the end. entrypoint.sh writes this node's lane count into `slots` -- Orion takes lock cardinality as an authoring decision, so it is a literal and never a reference. misfire_policy `skip`: a missed tick is a lane that was busy.
